related_gaps.rationale: This changes which paths force a standard task or a receipt; the page gate's commit-order and page checks are untouched.
The protected-path list is local policy; hosting rules stay the owner's to configure.

gap_review: Read the four open gaps. artifact-gate-holes and hosting-enforcement are near this work and unaffected; product-acceptance and platform-qualification are unrelated.

discoveries.summary: Skill frontmatter can register hooks, grant tools and run shell commands, so a skill can leave the receipt only while cargo xtask docs holds it to plain text (DOC011 to DOC013); the same carve-out was dropped in workflow-router for want of that check.
Agent host folders below the repository root, such as crates/app/.claude/skills/, escaped both the receipt and the tier rule; DOC014 now refuses them.

The edit guard gives no note for a bare top-level protected folder (rm -r .claude, rm -r xtask), and any one-segment path under .claude/skills/ gets a note even when handoff needs no receipt; completion and CI still judge the files.

discovery_review: Three discoveries, each recorded where its next reader looks: the frontmatter and nested-folder rules in docs/ARTIFACTS.md Task size, and the guard's coarseness in the implementation notes. One scratch-only observation from a page author (the guard reads a redirect target against the event's cwd after a cd) is carried in the buy-in doc.

documentation.rationale: ARTIFACTS.md Task size names the three ceremony skills and the docs checks that hold every other skill to text; COMPLETION.md says a skill folder outside the ceremony needs no receipt; the write-ticket skill tells ticket writers that other skills can change in a small task.
